group.label: General
group.comment: Gives the visitor's browser a short Cache-Control lifetime on storefront pages that Magento itself declared full page cacheable, without shortening how long the shared cache keeps them. Intended for installations where the Varnish VCL cannot be edited, or where there is no Varnish at all.

field.label: Browser lifetime
field.comment: Value in seconds; typical values are 60, 120 and 300. It is capped at Magento's own full page cache lifetime, so it never outlives what the shared cache stores. Behind Varnish the effective lifetime is this value minus the page's age in the Varnish cache — Varnish sends an Age header the origin cannot remove — so the benefit there is limited to recently cached pages. (Magento's own shipped VCL strips Age on deliver; a CDN or a customised VCL usually does not.) Magento's built-in full page cache sends no Age, so the browser gets the full value there.

field.label: Require revalidation
field.comment: Adds must-revalidate so the browser re-checks with the server once the lifetime expires instead of serving a stale copy.

field.label: Excluded URL patterns
field.comment: One regular expression per line, matched against the request path. Responses whose path matches keep Magento's stock cache headers. A line that is not a valid expression is ignored.
